title: Recognizing inertial frames
canonical_question: How can you recognize whether a given reference frame is inertial?
summary: To check a frame, imagine a body with zero net force and watch how it moves in that frame.
The ground is a good enough inertial frame for a game of billiards.

reuse.rationale: Authored fixture node for the E05 registry.

sections.heading: Watch a free body
sections.body_md: To check a frame, imagine a body with zero net force and watch how it moves in that frame. If it drifts at constant velocity in a straight line, the frame is inertial. If it curves or speeds up with nothing pushing it, the frame is not.

sections.heading: Typical cases
sections.body_md: The ground is a good enough inertial frame for a game of billiards. A merry-go-round or a braking bus is non-inertial, since objects appear to be flung about by no real force. The clue is always the unexplained motion of a force-free object.

key_points: Unexplained curving or speeding means non-inertial.
core.bridge_to_parent: It gives a recognition procedure for the objective’s concept.

seeds: Why does the ground count as inertial?
